question: On E-G1's frozen 240 items, does Qwen3-30B-A3B read news into typed fields better than the incumbent 7B -- by enough, reliably enough, and fast enough to replace it for L2 typing?

replace_7b_for_l2_typing_only_if: field accuracy (30B - 7B) >= 3 points on the SAME 240 items
AND the nightly typing backlog at the 30B's measured mean seconds/item fits in 8 hours
decision_rule.otherwise: KEEP_7B -- and the 30B file is a candidate to move to the archive drive (a decided KEEP is not a reason to hold 17.28 GiB on C:)
decision_rule.incomplete: INCOMPLETE if either arm did not read every item -- an unfinished comparison decides nothing, and never defaults to KEEP
decision_rule.scope: L2 typing ONLY. R2-Qwen3 (the monthly digest read) keeps its own registered two-condition rule in TRIAL-R2 s.6 / L4's protocol
